question: Who fails to know this reality, from celestial beings down to earth-born beings?
premises: It is not known by gods and gandharvas
An a fortiori contrast is introduced
It is even less known by those born on earth
inference: The reality is unknown even to gods and gandharvas, and certainly unknown to earth-born beings
plain_english: It is not known by gods and gandharvas; how much less by those born on earth.
